name: Quentin Pasley
summary: An American light heavyweight who won his UFC contract on the Contender Series in September with a R1 knockout of Arlind Berisha (4:41). He was 3-0 before that, with kickboxing, grappling and a 38-second boxing knockout in June. This is his UFC debut. Our data has no record for him yet.

how_they_fight.Striking: A puncher; his Contender Series win was a R1 knockout.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Has competed in grappling; untested in MMA.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Untested past R1 in the UFC.

keys_to_beat: Take him into deep water and test his grappling

news.text: Won a UFC contract with a R1 knockout of Arlind Berisha on the Contender Series.
